title: manihot sinuata var. genuina
intro: Manihot sinuata var. genuina, commonly known as wild cassava or bitter cassava, is a perennial shrub belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a plant rich in nutrients and has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate symptoms of diarrhea and dysentery. The health benefits of Manihot sinuata var. genuina include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
